# FPSOT naming specification

> How FPSOT projects name the identifiers that machines read: repositories, packages, Maven coordinates, paths, JSON fields, event types, code lists and files.

## Specification

- [Overview](spec/en/index.adoc): scope, parts and conformance.
- [Principles](spec/en/principles.adoc): NAM-001 to NAM-009.
- [Case and word form](spec/en/case.adoc): NAM-010 to NAM-017.
- [Repositories and packages](spec/en/repositories.adoc): NAM-020 to NAM-023.
- [Paths](spec/en/paths.adoc): NAM-030 to NAM-034.
- [Fields](spec/en/fields.adoc): NAM-040 to NAM-043.
- [Events](spec/en/events.adoc): NAM-050 to NAM-052.
- [Code lists](spec/en/code-lists.adoc): NAM-060, NAM-061.
- [Files](spec/en/files.adoc): NAM-070, NAM-071.
- [Stability](spec/en/stability.adoc): NAM-080 to NAM-084.
